original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚国防参谋长要求军方运用AI与先进监控应对不安全局势
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国防参谋长Olufemi Oluyede将军在卡杜纳为尼日利亚国防学院指挥中心及其他三个项目揭幕时，要求尼日利亚武装部队运用人工智能和先进监控系统等新兴技术，以提升态势感知和应对不断演变的安全威胁的能力。他表示当代安全挑战性质的变化要求军方持续适应并部署技术以增强作战效能。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚国防参谋长Olufemi Oluyede要求武装部队运用人工智能和先进监控系统应对安全威胁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Chief of Defence Staff, Gen. Olufemi Oluyede, has charged the Nigerian Armed Forces to harness emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and advanced surveillance systems, to improve situational awareness and response to evolving security threats.

key_facts.fact: Oluyede于周五在卡杜纳为尼日利亚国防学院指挥中心及其他三个项目揭幕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Oluyede said this on Friday in Kaduna while inaugurating the Nigerian Defence Academy Command Centre and three other projects at the academy.

key_facts.fact: 国防参谋长称当代安全挑战性质变化要求军方持续适应并部署技术
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The CDS said the changing nature of contemporary security challenges required the military to continuously adapt and deploy technology to enhance its operational effectiveness.

uncertainties: 该消息目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
